authority: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA) & Ministry of Energy (Power Division)

sources.issuing_authority: Ministry of Energy (Power Division), Government of Pakistan
sources.title: Uniform Tariff Determination for ex-WAPDA Distribution Companies (DISCOs)
sources.summary: Establishes baseline per-unit rates for Lifeline (<=50 units), Protected (1-100, 101-200), Unprotected slabs (1-700+), and Time-of-Use Peak/Off-Peak periods.

sources.title: Criteria for Classification of Protected Residential Consumers
sources.summary: Defines protected consumers as residential non-TOU users whose electricity consumption has not exceeded 200 units in any single month during the last 6 consecutive months.

sources.title: Financing Cost Surcharge (Debt Servicing Surcharge)
sources.summary: Surcharge levied on all electricity consumption (except lifeline) to fund power sector debt servicing and circular debt repayment.

sources.title: Monthly Fuel Charges Adjustment (FPA)
sources.summary: Monthly adjustment accounting for actual fuel mix costs (hydel, coal, RLNG, nuclear) vs. reference fuel costs established in base tariff.

sources.title: General Sales Tax (GST) on Electricity Consumption
sources.summary: Standard sales tax charged on total cost of electricity including base tariff and surcharges.

sources.title: Advance Tax on Electricity Consumption for Non-Filers
sources.summary: 7.5% withholding tax levied on domestic electricity bills exceeding Rs. 25,000 for consumers not appearing on the Active Taxpayer List (ATL).

sources.title: NEPRA (Alternative & Renewable Energy) Distributed Generation and Net Metering Regulations
sources.summary: Statutory rules permitting 3-phase consumers to install bidirectional meters and supply surplus distributed renewable generation back to the grid.
